title: Robert Kennedy on GDP
summary: A two-minute excerpt of Robert Kennedy's 1968 University of Kansas speech criticizing GDP as a measure of national worth. He notes it counts harmful spending while ignoring what makes life worthwhile.
why: HN quotes it whenever debating GDP and metrics of success beyond money.

quote.text: GDP includes money spent on addictive and harmful drugs, polluting industries, and many other ventures that are actively harmful.
